query: Key contributions and follow-ups of 'Attention Is All You Need' (2017)
highlights: The paper introduces scaled dot-product attention mechanism which is a key component of the Transformer architecture [1, p.4, Fig.2].
Multi-head attention allows the model to jointly attend to information from different representation subspaces [1, p.4, Fig.2].
The Transformer architecture achieves better BLEU scores than previous state-of-the-art models on English-to-German and English-to-French translations [1, p.8].
Table 3 shows variations on the Transformer architecture with different metrics on the English-to-German translation development set [1, p.9].
